NEJM Clinical Trials Dataset

Source: R/data.R
nejm.Rd

A collection of 39 clinical trials published in the New England Journal of Medicine, used to compare Bayesian analysis methods. Each row is a separate trial with binary outcomes.

Usage

nejm

Format

A data frame with 39 rows and 10 variables:

No.

Trial reference number.

P.value

Frequentist p-value.

BF01

Bayes factor in favor of H0.

y1

Number of events in group 1 (control).

y2

Number of events in group 2 (treatment).

n1

Number of subjects in group 1 (control).

n2

Number of subjects in group 2 (treatment).

y1n1

Event rate in group 1 (y1/n1).

y2n2

Event rate in group 2 (y2/n2).

ynavg

Average event rate across both groups.

References

Irons, N.J. and Cinelli, C. (2025). Causally Sound Priors for Binary Experiments. Bayesian Analysis. doi:10.1214/25-BA1506

Examples

data(nejm)
